description: ASHFALL runtime performance references for scripts/ci/perf-baseline-gate.py. A measured median more than default_tolerance_ratio over its reference is SUSPICIOUS. Missing entries are NO-REFERENCE and never fail. References are provisional host observations and must be refreshed from a quiet host run before they are treated as authoritative.

measurement_context.note: Day-advance and save references are host observations on a shared, concurrently-loaded machine; refresh from a quiet window. Sprint-1 references (cold_start, load_30d, checksum_30d, large_shelter_*, long_replay_720d) are provisional single host runs from 2026-10-02. min_delta_ms is an absolute floor: sub-millisecond benchmarks must exceed it before a relative breach flags, because timer noise dominates at that scale.

save_30d.note: Steady-state envelope capture latency after warmup=1.

load_30d.note: Envelope deserialize latency; provisional single host run.

checksum_30d.note: SaveChecksum.Compute over the 30-day payload; provisional single host run.

cold_start.note: Core proxy harness construction (roster/journal/world seed + owner registration); provisional single host run.

large_shelter_50.note: Per-day advance at 50 survivors after a 90-day soak; measures coordinator/owner overhead (survivor loop is structural).

large_shelter_100.note: Per-day advance at 100 survivors after a 90-day soak; coordinator/owner overhead only.

large_shelter_250.note: Per-day advance at 250 survivors after a 90-day soak; coordinator/owner overhead only.

large_shelter_500.note: Per-day advance at 500 survivors after a 90-day soak; coordinator/owner overhead only.

long_replay_720d.note: 720-day replay at the stress tier on one reused harness; provisional single host run.
